title: Sherrye KS Probable NDE 7246
content: I was up high looking down on a hospital scene. I saw a lot of people in scrubs standing around a table or bed. I did not understand at first that I (my body) was on that bed, and my spirit had left. I saw my husband and knew he was very distressed. I called out to him, over and over, but he did not respond. I then found myself standing on the bank of a body of water that was like a river, but it was not flowing. It was black and looked bottomless and cold. As I stood there trying to figure out where I was and what I needed to do, I saw that a storm was brewing to the east. I knew I was facing north. The wind began blowing, and I could see distant lightning. I looked around for shelter. I looked across the river and only saw darkness. I looked to my left and saw a building a few hundred yards away. Then I saw my friend, Mary. Mary said, 'Come with me. We are having a worship service there.' I was then in that building. I don't know how I got there. I participated as best as I could in a play that was being performed about Jesus' birth, but I was uncomfortable. I didn't really want to be there. I was back on the bank of the black river. Again, I looked across, and this time I saw Paradise. The bank of the other shore was made of crystalline sand that sparkled like diamonds in the beautiful, bright light that shone there. Beyond the beach grew beautiful, lush foliage, all kinds of beautiful plants. My eyes were drawn back down the beach where I saw, to my amazement, my friend, Penny. She was dressed in beautiful flowing garments. She smiled and beckoned for me. I saw movement in the foliage and saw the head of an albino tiger emerge from the shrubs. I looked to Penny thinking I should warn her, but she looked toward the magnificent creature, smiled and extended her hand. The tiger went to her and stood calmly by her side. I thought to myself, 'That's where I want to go. I want to go to Paradise.' I was not allowed to cross the river then. My soul was taken on a journey. There was much I had to see and learn first. I was shown a war going on in the desert. Maybe it was Desert Storm, but probably it was just the constant war that goes on. I saw scenes of man's inhumanity toward man. I saw some of the horrible things people do to one another. I was taken to the time of Jesus' crucifixion. I felt the hatred and hopelessness of the people there. After that, I was taken to a place of rest where I was cared for and nurtured by a wonderful female spirit. It seemed like I was there for a million years, because that is how long it took my soul to heal from the horrors I had seen. After that, I saw things that I didn't understand until I experienced them later in my life. I was in a train going to nowhere, an elevator, a huge tank filled with water in the basement of a room with thick wires coming down from the ceiling. I was told that my youngest son and his wife wouldn't be able to have children but was assured that 'the children of the world' would be theirs. In 2006, they adopted two of those children of the world. I was shown that one of my grandchildren would experience some kind of situation that would cause my son great fear and pain. Nothing has happened yet; so, I still don't know what that will be. Finally, I was taken to a place by a woman I didn't know. She told me we were going to a place where the most evil of evil people were held. The people there were dressed in white jumpsuits. Every once and a while a door would open and one of them would be sent out. The woman told me that those people who got out were allowed to leave, because they didn't love Jesus and that was the only way I could get away from there. She asked me 3 times if I hated Him. Three times, I told her no, that I love Him. It was only then that I made it to Paradise. When I got there, I was taken through huge gates into a city. The city was translucent and bright. There were people everywhere. They were celebrating, joyous that I had arrived. I joined them in celebration for a while. I knew I was in the presence of the Holy Spirit. I cannot adequately describe the peace and love I felt. It was a place I never wanted to leave. I was approached by another woman, again someone I didn't know. She asked, 'Are you ready to meet the King?' I said, 'Yes, I am.' She said, 'Come with me.' She took me into a beautiful room. There was no one else around. The room was filled with love and peace. She said to me, 'Wait here. I'll see if He is ready for you.' I was there for what seemed like an eternity. I felt so good, so at rest. I thought to myself, 'This is so comfortable. I hope I don't fall asleep.' That was it. I had to come back. He was not ready for me. This existence I returned to felt dirty and evil. I did not want to be back here, and I can't wait to leave again to be free of this body/shell that fastens my soul in this realm. Wonderful things await!

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus; Holy Spirit; 'the King' (implied as Jesus/Christ but not explicitly identified).

environment.environment_other_detail: Black, non-flowing bottomless-looking river; storm with wind and lightning; crystalline sand beach; lush foliage; huge gates; translucent bright city; 'beautiful room' filled with love and peace.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She was told there was 'much I had to see and learn first.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Prophetic/premonitory scenes (son’s infertility/adoption; future fear/pain event); scenes of war and crucifixion; 'place where the most evil of evil people were held'; celebration in a city; waiting to meet 'the King'.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE over hospital, then river/storm, then building/worship play, back to river, then Paradise seen but not crossed, then instructional/journey scenes (war/crucifixion/rest/future scenes/evil holding area), then Paradise/city/celebration, then waiting room, then return.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Returned to the riverbank scene multiple times.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Black, non-flowing bottomless river with storm; being drawn into a building for a worship service/play about Jesus’ birth; albino tiger in Paradise; extended 'soul healing' period; symbolic future scenes (train to nowhere, elevator, huge water tank with thick wires); 'most evil of evil people' in white jumpsuits and being asked three times if she hated Jesus; celebratory city behind huge gates; waiting room to meet 'the King' but 'He was not ready.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'Come with me. We are having a worship service there.'; 'That's where I want to go. I want to go to Paradise.'; 'the children of the world' would be theirs.; 'Are you ready to meet the King?'; 'Wait here. I'll see if He is ready for you.'; 'This existence I returned to felt dirty and evil.'
